purpose: R253 non-financial HS300 weakest-link quality factor versus a matched quality-cash control

universe.industry_source: current ext_hy_ths industry snapshot; not historical PIT

factor.formula: management_ocf_gm_min_rank = min(rank_pct(management_expense_ratio_4q_low), rank_pct(ocf_margin_4q), rank_pct(gross_margin_yoy_improvement_q)); 1 is best and 0 is worst
factor.pit_rule: components inherit their existing financial PIT dates; percentile ranks and the minimum are computed only from same-date values within historical nonfinancial HS300 membership

pit_audit.rule: same-date cross-sectional percentile ranks of management expense (inverted), OCF margin and gross-margin YoY improvement within current nonfinancial historical HS300 members; min of the three percentile ranks; all components required
pit_audit.rank_normalization: rank_pct = (number_of_names - descending_average_rank) / (number_of_names - 1); 1 is best and 0 is worst

samples.rolling_1y: 252-trading-day rolling compounded return over the stitched 2023-2026 curve
samples.recent_12m: last 252 trading-day returns of the stitched 2023-2026 curve

execution.cost_stress: 4x and 5x scale all four components proportionally
execution.stitching: two segment returns compounded into one curve; first day of each later segment skipped

caveats: The weakest-link rule can become sparse when a strong component is paired with a weak one.
Average percentile ranks can produce ties, including a 1st-percentile value of zero.
Management expenses do not capture selling expenses and may be classified inconsistently across firms.
All components use current financial snapshots and inherit restatement risk.
The discovery segment starts in 2023 to keep all three components at complete coverage.
The industry snapshot used to exclude financials is current rather than historical PIT.
The full curve is stitched from two system-engine segments; segment boundaries can reset an open position.
Trade P&L shares are contribution diagnostics from two segments each starting at 1,000,000 notional, not a compounded-return decomposition.
The factor is research-only until every preregistered gate passes; passing would justify paper-trading validation, not production deployment.
